cohort: The study included 219 pregnant women with diet-controlled gestational diabetes mellitus who delivered at 39 or 40 weeks.
finding: There were no statistically significant differences in maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes between women with diet-controlled GDM delivering at 39 weeks versus 40 weeks, although a non-significant trend for higher shoulder dystocia and preeclampsia was observed at 40 weeks.
mod_finding: No statistically significant difference was found in delivery mode between women delivering at 39 weeks and 40 weeks (p=0.581).
